capabilities: Beautify JSON, XML and SOAP with configurable indentation
Minify and validate payloads with line-level error reporting
Insert formatted output back into a source-mode note
Compare two payloads with a structural diff report
Decode entity-encoded XML and extract embedded XML or JSON
disambiguation: Not an API or network client; it only reformats and compares text you paste, upload or select.
extras: Parsing stays on the device: no network calls, DTDs and external entities are rejected, and input over 20 × 1024 × 1024 characters is refused. Optional saved editor text is off by default and stored unencrypted in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to pretty-print, validate or compare JSON, XML and SOAP payloads that end up in notes.
summary: Formats, minifies, validates and structurally diffs JSON, XML and SOAP text in a side panel or on the current selection.
